subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the existing aborted-turn drop policy for orphaned assistant tool calls, matching prompt-send sanitization, or should maintainers require a different recovery policy before merge?
rationale: Both drop and synthesize are technically plausible session-state policies; choosing whether to discard interrupted assistant tool-call turns from summaries is a maintainer product/runtime decision rather than a mechanical code defect.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this fix shape after exact-head review, accepting that aborted tool-call turns are removed from compaction summaries to keep provider transcripts valid.

options.title: Require synthetic interrupted results
options.body: Ask for an alternate implementation that preserves the interrupted assistant turn by inserting explicit synthetic tool results with tests and provider proof.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of a larger session-recovery design that covers compaction, replay, and durable repair together.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this fix shape after exact-head review, accepting that aborted tool-call turns are removed from compaction summaries to keep provider transcripts valid.

likelyOwner.reason: The policy hinges on the transcript repair behavior he introduced and repeatedly hardened, even though recent compaction lines were refactored by others.
